new-public-functions.text: Thirteen new functions: path selection, fee reserve, minimum change, funded and collateral outputs, lifecycle-only resizing, request deposits, budget verification, funding requirement, the filtered provider, funding, the aggregate limit check, and evaluate-and-rebalance before signing.

node-entry-point.text: One new node entry runs the existing setup with no fixed funding floor; the lifecycle layer's own preflight decides.

test-surface.text: Five regression cases: exact-boundary accept, two over-memory refusals, one over-steps refusal, one refusal-text identity, and one reserved-input exclusion.
